wiki.title: Abi Boatman
wiki.extract: Elle Abigail "Abi" Boatman is an American politician who is a Democratic member of the Kansas House of Representatives since 2026. Boatman was first elected by precinct leaders to fill a vacant seat in January 2026 when her predecessor Silas Miller was elected to the Kansas Senate. She represents the 86th district in southeast Wichita.
